caption: Cheerful children's sing-along song for preschool TV in the style of modern nursery-rhyme channels, warm friendly lead vocals with a happy group of cartoon animal voices joining on the chorus, call and response, gentle ukulele, soft glockenspiel, music box, warm soft bass, very light percussion, playful animal sound effects, catchy repeating chorus, gentle, sleepy, warm lullaby feel but still catchy, major key, polished modern kids music production, clear diction, easy for toddlers to sing along
lyrics:
[Intro]
Hey hey, it's the Paws and Claws Club,
The stars are out. It's bedtime.

[Chorus]
Goodnight, goodnight, the moon is bright,
Snuggle up and hold on tight!
Close your eyes and count to three,
Sweet dreams for you and me!

[Verse]
Rory puts on his star pyjamas,
Gives a great big yawn, ahhh!
Yawn, yawn, one, two, three,
Rory's sleepy as can be!

[Chorus]
Goodnight, goodnight, the moon is bright,
Snuggle up and hold on tight!
Close your eyes and count to three,
Sweet dreams for you and me!

[Verse]
Ziggy curls up in her basket,
Soft and warm like a fluffy blanket!
Purr, purr, one, two, three,
Ziggy's sleepy as can be!

[Chorus]
Goodnight, goodnight, the moon is bright,
Snuggle up and hold on tight!
Close your eyes and count to three,
Sweet dreams for you and me!

[Verse]
Waffles hugs his favourite teddy,
Fluffs his pillow, now he's ready!
Snuggle, snuggle, one, two, three,
Waffles is sleepy as can be!

[Chorus]
Goodnight, goodnight, the moon is bright,
Snuggle up and hold on tight!
Close your eyes and count to three,
Sweet dreams for you and me!

[Verse]
Pebble wraps his yellow scarf,
Tucks in his flippers with a laugh!
Shh, shh, one, two, three,
Pebble's sleepy as can be!

[Bridge]
Twinkle, twinkle, little light,
Owls are hooting in the night,
The Paws and Claws Club says goodnight,
Sleep tight, sleep tight.

[Chorus]
Goodnight, goodnight, the moon is bright,
Snuggle up and hold on tight!
Close your eyes and count to three,
Sweet dreams for you and me!

[Chorus]
Goodnight, goodnight, the moon is bright,
Snuggle up and hold on tight!
Close your eyes and count to three,
Sweet dreams for you and me!

[Outro]
Goodnight, friends. Sweet dreams.
